## What changes?

Describe the problem and the smallest useful fix. Link an issue if one exists.

## How was it checked?

List commands actually run and manual checks actually completed. If a check was
blocked, explain the blocker. Do not mark unrun checks as passing.

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

For a model change, include a deterministic test and state any changed invariant.
For a UI change, include desktop/mobile evidence and a keyboard check where relevant.

## Review notes

- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior or formulas.
- [ ] New dependencies, assets, and copied material have suitable license notices.
- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain synthetic data only.
- [ ] Any new network, storage, or privacy behavior is called out explicitly.

Mention limitations or follow-up work. Delete sections that genuinely do not apply.
